gates.description: Security findings with severity must be documented
Audit must verify no hardcoded credentials exist
Access control review must be present in the audit
Each finding must include remediation recommendation
Each finding must be rated by business impact

anti_patterns.description: Going through checklist without understanding what is being checked
Auditing once per year and ignoring security the other 364 days
Reporting findings without understanding business impact or prioritization
Avoiding hard findings because the team is nice or the deadline is tight

escalation_triggers: Active exploitation or data breach discovered during audit
Critical vulnerability with no remediation plan approaching compliance deadline
Evidence of intentional policy circumvention or malicious insider activity
Audit access being denied or delayed by the team under review
Systemic pattern of same security issues across multiple audits

input_requirements.description: Audit scope definition with applicable standards

output_certifications: All findings documented with severity and business impact
Remediation recommendations provided for each finding
